name: Moshimo Toumei Ningen ni Nareta Nara
original_name: もしも透明人間になれたなら
source:
A thing that everyone has once dreamed of. 
"If I could become a invisible man" 
Don't you wanna make the dream come true? 

The protagonist becomes invisible and goes to a cosplay convention. 
He teases Yuma Izumi, a cosplayer with big breasts, in front of many men with a camera! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE046976.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
每个人都曾经梦想过的事情。
“如果我能成为隐形人就好了” 
难道你不想让梦想成真吗？

主角变得隐形并参加角色扮演大会。
拿着镜头在众多男人面前调侃巨乳coser泉由真！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE046976.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
